import-board-instruction-orgmode: Paste an Org mode file, as Emacs, Orgzly or Beorg write it. Top-level headings become lists and second-level headings become cards. TODO and DONE, priorities, tags, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE and CLOSED are kept, and checkboxes and deeper headings become checklists.

feature-views-overview-desc: Ol namba, bungim long grup bihainim man o meri i kisim wok, plen bilong wok, bot bilong lukautim wok na bikpela bot.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Tripela lukluk bilong ol sat bilong Gantt.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Ol wok bilong prodak i stap yet, ol sotpela taim bilong wok, ripot bilong dispela taim na spid bilong wok.
feature-views-flow-charts: Ol sat bilong ron bilong wok
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Wok i stap yet, wok i pinis, ron bilong wok i bung, taim bilong mekim wok na taim long askim inap long pinis, hamas wok i pinis, hamas taim wok i wet, ol samting i pasim wok, Monte Carlo na ol arapela mak bilong ron bilong wok.
feature-views-map-desc: Ol kat olsem mak long piksa yu putim i go antap.
feature-approval-required: Larim ol samting ol nupela vesin bilong WeKan i skruim i no wok inap wanpela admin i mekim ol i wok
feature-preview-admins: Ol admin i lukim ol samting i no wok bilong traim ol pastaim
feature-pilot-users: Ol manmeri bilong traim sistem husat i lukim ol samting i no wok tu
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Ol nem bilong yusa, brukim wantaim koma
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Seivim pinis. I no painim ol dispela nem bilong yusa:
card-field-visibility-desc: Ol hap long Ol seting bilong bot / Kat em ol bot i ken soim. Sapos yu rausim mak long wanpela hap, dispela hap bai hait long olgeta kat, ol liklik kat na Ol seting bilong bot / Kat long olgeta bot. Ol data bilong kat na ol seting bilong bot i no senis. Sapos yu putim mak gen, olgeta bot bai soim ol samting olsem ol seting bilong ol bipo. Wanwan bot i gat oda bilong ol hap bilong em yet.
cards-loading-auto: Makim em yet (ol bikpela bot tasol i lodim kat taim yu nidim)
cards-loading-lazy: Lodim ol kat i kamap ples klia tasol
cards-loading-description: WeKan i save lodim ol kat bilong bot em yet: bikpela bot (i winim mak bilong sais) i lodim ol kat yu lukim nau tasol (taim yu skrol i go moa) wantaim namba bilong ol kat i save senis wantaim data. Olsem na em i ran kwik na yusim liklik memori na data bilong netwok. Ol liklik bot i lodim olgeta kat bilong mekim olgeta wok i stap isi long yusim. Yu no gat samting bilong setim. Ol admin inap makim yet wanpela wei wantaim ol envaironmen veriabel CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) na CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Wok bilong lodim ol kat taim yu nidim tasol i stap long traim yet: namba bilong ol kat na mak bilong WIP i stret, tasol ol lukluk bilong Kalenda/Tebol/Gantt na makim planti kat wantaim i soim ol kat i lod pinis tasol. Lodim gen ol bot i stap op bihain long yu senisim dispela.
render-links-as-plain-text: Soim ol link olsem rait nating
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Sapos dispela i wok, olgeta link (ol markdown link olsem [label](url) na ol HTML tag <a href>) i save kamap olsem rait nating yu no inap klikim, long olgeta bokis bilong rait i gat stail (nem bilong bot na kat, toksave, ol tok, ol lis bilong sekim na ol arapela). Dispela i pasim ol link yu inap klikim i giamanim yu. Dispela seting i no wok long stat, olsem na yu inap klikim ol link yet.
always-show-code-as-text: Soim olgeta kod olsem rait nating oltaim
always-show-code-as-text-description: Sapos dispela i wok, rait i gat stail i no kamap olsem markdown o HTML: olgeta sos i kamap olsem rait nating long olgeta bokis bilong rait i gat stail (nem bilong bot na kat, toksave, ol tok, ol lis bilong sekim na ol arapela). Dispela i soim ol samting i hait — ol HTML koment (<!-- -->), ples ol markdown link i go long en, JavaScript na ol arapela kod. Olsem na olgeta kod i stap ples klia, yu no inap klikim, na em i no ran. Dispela seting i no wok long stat, olsem na markdown i kamap olsem bipo.
disable-all-import-description: Sapos dispela i wok, olgeta rot bilong kisim i kam insait i pas: kisim bot long WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea na Forgejo, na mekim kopi bilong bot tu. Ol rot bilong kisim i kam insait long menyu i hait na server i no orait long wanpela rikwes bilong kisim i kam insait. Dispela seting i no wok long stat.
disable-all-export-description: Sapos dispela i wok, olgeta rot bilong salim i go aut i pas: salim bot olsem WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, o i go long NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, na salim wanpela fail i pas i go aut tu. Ol rot bilong salim i go aut long menyu i hait na server i no orait long wanpela rikwes bilong salim i go aut. Dispela seting i no wok long stat.
disable-import-avatars: Pasim ol piksa bilong yusa long kam insait
disable-import-avatars-description: Sapos dispela i wok, ol piksa bilong yusa i no kam insait. Dispela i karamap kisim i kam insait long WeKan JSON na Trello, na kisim piksa i kam long ol arapela sevis bilong makim yusa taim yu go insait (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Ol nem na arapela data i kam insait yet; ol piksa bilong yusa tasol i no kam insait. Dispela seting i no wok long stat.
disable-export-avatars: Pasim ol piksa bilong yusa long go aut
disable-export-avatars-description: Sapos dispela i wok, ol piksa bilong yusa i no go aut taim yu salim bot i go aut (WeKan JSON na CSV). Ol nem bilong yusa na arapela data i go aut yet; ol piksa bilong yusa tasol i no go aut. Dispela seting i no wok long stat.
anonymize-import-users: Haitim tru nem na mak bilong ol yusa i kam insait
anonymize-import-users-description: Sapos dispela i wok, taim yu kisim bot WeKan JSON i kam insait, em i senisim nem bilong yusa, fulnem na ol fes leta bilong nem bilong olgeta yusa i kam insait wantaim ol nem i gat namba (user1, user2, ...). Em i rausim piksa bilong ol na raitim gen ol @username (na ol bokis requested-by / assigned-by) insait long ol kat na ol tok i kam insait. Em i no seivim tru nem o mak bilong wanpela yusa long sos bot. Tok "user" i bihainim tokples bilong man i kisim bot i kam insait. Dispela seting i no wok long stat.
anonymize-export-users: Haitim tru nem na mak bilong ol yusa i go aut
anonymize-export-users-description: Sapos dispela i wok, taim yu salim bot i go aut, em i senisim nem bilong yusa, fulnem na ol fes leta bilong nem bilong olgeta yusa i go aut wantaim ol nem i gat namba (user1, user2, ...). Em i rausim piksa bilong ol na raitim gen ol @username (na ol bokis requested-by / assigned-by) insait long ol kat na ol tok. Fail i go aut i no gat tru nem o mak bilong wanpela yusa. Tok "user" i bihainim tokples bilong man i salim bot i go aut. Dispela seting i no wok long stat.
anonymize-account: Haitim tru nem na mak bilong akaun
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Yu laik haitim tru nem na mak bilong dispela akaun? Dispela bai senisim nem bilong yusa, fulnem na adres imel inap oltaim wantaim ol veliu bilong kisim ples bilong ol, rausim piksa bilong yusa na pasim rot bilong go insait. Em i no rausim akaun: ol bot, kat na tok i holim histori bilong ol na soim dispela akaun yet, tasol tru nem na mak bilong em i hait. Yu no inap senisim dispela i go bek olsem bipo.
disable-activities-description: Sapos dispela i wok, ol rekot bilong ol wok i no seiv na i no kamap long wanpela ples (ba long sait bilong bot na tab bilong ol wok long kat). I no gat histori bilong husat i mekim wanem samting i stap. Dispela seting i no wok long stat.
disable-notifications-description: Sapos dispela i wok, WeKan i no salim toksave bilong bihainim (insait long app, long imel o ol arapela sevis) long wanpela wok. Ol wok inap gat rekot yet (sapos yu no pasim dispela tu antap); ol toksave tasol i no go aut. Dispela seting i no wok long stat.
disable-watch-description: Sapos dispela i wok, wok bilong bihainim i pas — ol yusa i no inap bihainim ol bot, lis o kat bilong kisim toksave, na olgeta traim bilong senisim mak bilong bihainim bai no orait. Dispela seting i no wok long stat.
backup-description: Mekim bekap bilong ol fail i pas, ol piksa bilong yusa na/ o data (olgeta grup bilong rait em ol i no fail i pas o piksa bilong yusa). Fail .zip i go stret long ples bilong seiv yu makim, na i no gat fail bilong sotpela taim, olsem backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip. Em i gat YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars na /data insait. Ol ples bilong seiv long klaut (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) i yusim ol tok hait bilong go insait yu bin putim long ol tab bilong seiv bilong ol.
backup-scope: Ol samting bilong mekim kopi bilong bekap
backup-scope-description: Dispela hap WeKan olgeta, o wanpela oganaisesen. Kopi bilong kisim bek bilong wanpela oganaisesen i gat ol bot bilong en na olgeta samting long ol, wantaim ol fail i pas long ol dispela bot. Em i no gat ol akaun bilong yusa na ol seting bilong dispela hap WeKan, bikos olgeta oganaisesen i yusim ol wantaim. Taim yu kisim bek kopi bilong wanpela oganaisesen, em i rait long ol bot bilong dispela oganaisesen tasol.

backup-done: Wok bilong mekim kopi bilong kisim bek i pinis
backup-schedule: Ol kopi bilong bekap long taim yu makim
backup-list: Soim lis bilong ol kopi bilong kisim bek
continuous-backup-description: I salim olgeta senis long detabes, ol fail i pas, ol piksa bilong yusa na ol rekot i go long wanpela folda insait long sampela sekon tasol, olsem na yu inap kisim bek data olsem em i bin stap long wanem taim yu laikim. Em i wok wantaim bekap i gat taim bilong en, em i save mekim ol fulpela akaiv.

continuous-backup-saved: Ol seting bilong bekap oltaim i seiv pinis

gcs-key-filename-description: Sapos yu laik: rot long server i go long JSON fail i gat ki bilong akaun bilong sevis.

gcs-permissions-note: Givim akaun bilong sevis bilong WeKan rait long ritim na raitim long baket: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → baket bilong yu → Permissions → Grant access. Long “New principals”, putim kopi bilong imel bilong akaun bilong sevis — veliu “client_email” long ki JSON bilong yu — na makim wok “Storage Object Admin” na Save.

s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: larim i stap nating (em i yusim endpoint bilong hap). S3 i wok wantaim: kisim Endpoint URL long konsol bilong MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces bilong yu.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → baket bilong yu → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → nem bilong baket bilong yu (o Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → yusa bilong yu → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → makim “Application running outside AWS” → Create access key. Em i kamap olsem “Access key ID”.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Long wankain pes olsem Access key ID; “Secret access key” i kamap wanpela taim tasol taim yu wokim ki — kisim kopi long dispela taim (o Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akaun bilong yu → nem i stap antap (na aninit long Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name tu).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akaun bilong yu → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akaun bilong yu → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akaun bilong yu → Data storage → Containers → kontena bilong yu (o + Container bilong wokim wanpela).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → makim projek antap → ID bilong projek bilong yu (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → nem bilong baket bilong yu (o Create bilong wokim wanpela).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Rot long server bilong WeKan i go long JSON fail bilong ki bilong akaun bilong sevis yu kisim i kam daun (wokim aninit). Yusim dispela O putim kopi bilong JSON long bokis aninit.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → akaun bilong sevis bilong yu → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (kisim fail i kam daun). Putim kopi bilong ol samting insait long fail hia, o seivim fail na makim rot bilong en antap.

email-recovery-description: Wanpela lain bilong wanwan manmeri i kisim tok. Painim long ID bilong yusa. Ol tok insait long mesej na ol hap bilong adres imel bilong manmeri i kisim tok i no kamap. Stop liklik i holim ol mesej i stap nau na ol nupela mesej bai kam; Go het gen i traim salim ol mesej long lain gen nau. Rausim i rausim ol mesej ol i putim long lain inap long taim bilong askim. Sapos sistem i wok long salim tok, wet liklik na traim gen. Mesej ol i stat long salim pinis i no inap kam bek, na sapos yumi no save gut olsem mesej i go pinis o nogat, ol inap salim em gen. Ol mesej i no inap go olgeta na ol i bin traim inap long mak ol i stap yet bilong sekim. Traim ol mesej i no go gen i statim nupela raun bilong traim, na sapos ol i bin stopim salim tok bilong wet liklik, dispela i stap yet.

stuck-sync-operation-heading: List Sync operations that cannot be replayed
stuck-sync-operation-description: Each of these saved List Sync operations stopped part way and can no longer be finished, because its list was removed, recreated or reconfigured, or the user who started it lost write access. While one is pending, that list cannot Sync. Discard it to let the list Sync again: changes already applied stay, the remaining saved changes are never written, and the next Sync compares the list with its source again.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: The list was removed, recreated or its Sync settings changed
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: The user who started it no longer has write access to the whole list
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Saved by an earlier WeKan version without what started it
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: The record of who started it is missing
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: It can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Discard this saved List Sync operation? Changes it already applied stay; the rest are never written. The list can then Sync again.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: No List Sync operations are waiting for review.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Discard some and refresh to see more.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Could not load the List Sync operations. Refresh to try again.
stuck-sync-operation-missing: This operation is no longer pending.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: This operation has not been found stuck, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: This operation can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it was not discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: This list is syncing right now. Try again in a moment.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
interrupted-import-heading: Board imports that stopped before finishing
interrupted-import-description: Each of these board imports stopped part way - the server restarted, or the import failed - and left a partial board. An import cannot be continued, because its source file is not kept. Keep the board as it is, or discard it and import the file again. Discarding removes the board this import created and everything on it, including anything added to it since.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Being discarded; discard again to finish
interrupted-import-scrum: Its Scrum stage has its own checkpoint (__state__, __next__ of __total__ steps). If you keep the board, finish or discard it from the board's Scrum import recovery.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ swimlanes, __lists__ lists, __cards__ cards, __checklists__ checklists, __comments__ comments, __attachments__ attachments
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Keep this partial board as it is? Nothing is removed, and the import is no longer listed here.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Discard this import? The board it created and everything on it are removed permanently.
interrupted-import-empty: No interrupted board imports are waiting for review.
interrupted-import-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Keep or discard some and refresh to see more.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Could not load the interrupted board imports. Refresh to try again.
interrupted-import-missing: This import is no longer recorded.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: This import is not waiting for a decision any more.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: The board with this id was not created by this import, so it was not touched.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Its Scrum stage is still being written or recovered. Try again in a few minutes.
interrupted-import-failed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
